desc: Cultural & community hub with a café & pottery studio championing arts, theater, crafts & yoga.
addr: 2906, 2907, 80 Feet Rd, HAL 2nd Stage, Kodihalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560008, India

rev.t: Too good. Went there for a bake sale event. Open space. There were several other stuff going on out of which I liked the music show which happened ig around 7.42pm. Nice ambience.

This is one of the awesome places I have visited in Bangalore. On the ground floor there is library cum restaurant cum Handicrafts shop. They also host a paid Pottery workshop every week. It is a nice place to spend long hours. …

Like this place because of plays and it's permanent place where performance going on. They have two floors ground and top floor for this.. I was in ground floor.. Sitting is good there not fansy if you expecting much.
